card.name: Dose amounts in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Mostly the first digit of a dose number (such as the 3 in 300 mg or the 1 in 1 gram) in recommended-dosage sentences. It also fires on a few mid-word pieces like re- in reconstituted or reactivation.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a strength or amount in a recommended-dose sentence for a tablet.
modes.example: is one <<3>>00 mg tablet taken orally once daily

modes.label: Start of re- words
modes.description: The re- piece at the start of words like reconstituted or reactivation in drug-label text.

modes.label: Scattered other spots
modes.description: Odd single words or pieces, including a French word and a linking word in a drug-interaction list.
